value.description: binding value, name of the selected tab, the default value is the name of first tab
value.description_zh: 绑定值，选中选项卡的 name

:v-model.description: binding value, name of the selected tab, the default value is the name of first tab
:v-model.description_zh: 绑定值，选中选项卡的 name

editable.description: whether Tab is addable and closable
editable.description_zh: 标签是否同时可增加和关闭

stretch.description: whether width of tab automatically fits its container
stretch.description_zh: 标签的宽度是否自撑开

:before-leave.description: hook function before switching tab. If `false` is returned or a `Promise` is returned and then is rejected, switching will be prevented
:before-leave.type: Function(activeName: TabPaneName, oldActiveName: TabPaneName) => Awaitable<void | boolean>
:before-leave.description_zh: 切换标签之前的钩子，若返回 false 或者返回 Promise 且被 reject，则阻止切换。

events.name: tab-click
events.description: triggers when a tab is clicked

events.name: tab-remove
events.description: triggers when tab-remove button is clicked
events.description_zh: 点击 tab 移除按钮后触发

events.name: tab-add
events.description: triggers when tab-add button is clicked
events.description_zh: 点击 tabs 的新增按钮后触发

events.name: edit

events.description_zh: 点击 tabs 的新增按钮或 tab 被关闭后触发
